fixture_policy: Native tests construct AST values directly. Exact upstream writer string assertions are distinguished from independently derived structural, formatting and boundary examples. The two source grammar fixtures are recorded for scope/provenance only and are NOT executed by this writer-only port. No C++ execution is claimed by these native fixtures.
implemented_scope: Complete annotation AST and both source text writer modes only; overall ProForma header remains partial.
remaining_scope: structured parse errors and text parsers
JSON readers and writers for all variants
modification resolution and AASequence conversion with diagnostics/policies
chain/ion mass and m/z including try/issue/can operations
ordinary and two-chain XLMS spectrum operations, including missing native XLMS backend
native_differences: Owned Arc resolved chemistry instead of a non-owning pointer; standard Clone and value PartialEq.
Unknown ConversionIssue position uses Option instead of SIZE_MAX.
ASCII-only individual character fields; annotation strings retain Unicode bytes.
Consumed nonfinite floats and i32 adduct arithmetic overflow return errors atomically.
The i32::MIN aggregate-charge absolute value uses a defined unsigned magnitude.
Explicit empty/zero Rust defaults replace uninitialized source aggregate scalar states.
Classic-locale numeric formatting without process locale mutation.
preserved_source_quirks: Stored order is unchanged in Canonical mode.
Mass spelling bypasses numeric mass in Lossless; otherwise fixed4 including +-0.0000.
Lossless score begins defaultfloat6 and inherits fixed4 after numeric mass formatting; Canonical scores fixed2; chain streams reset.
Ion.name omitted; single chain charge omitted; per-chain ion charges emitted only for chimeric ions.
Label.type ignored; empty INFO is label-only only in square brackets.
All glycan counts emitted, no separators; adduct total-charge suffix emitted.
No grammar, formula, glycan lookup, ambiguity or cross-link validation during writing.

limits.policy: One shared writer ledger across chains, charged collection lengths, copied text and output growth before work/allocation. Output cap bounds requested output capacity, not allocator bookkeeping or preexisting caller AST. Only consumed fields are traversed.

licensing: Source-derived native code retains OpenMS BSD-3-Clause copyright/SPDX notices; no new runtime data resource is packaged.
